sprints.theme: Saturate 4×H200 — GPU-bound by killing I/O+CPU tax in the encode path
sprints.summary: Shipped 2026-05-27 (zarr-consolidate) + 2026-05-28 (frame-precompute). Both perf wins land; corpus encode hit 308 fps/GPU peak via the in-process stream_encode.py path that replaced the optimisation targets. Side-quest: bench harness moved to the same in-process pattern (commit c759282) — ~55× speedup; rFID gate measurement landed at 16.25 on the 100-shot in-process bench (job 1208918).

Closed 2026-05-29 with a NEGATIVE-but-decisive result that re-founded the project. The Open-MAGVIT2 decoder fine-tune (v0 0.1·LPIPS, Option B 1.0·LPIPS) was confirmed ~7pt WORSE than the untrained baseline on rFID — robust to rFID pool size (Option D, 8 & 32 frame) and to decoder precision (job 1209184 ruled out a bf16-measurement artifact). Conclusion: tuning a 2D decoder against rFID is a dead-end, and rFID is the wrong north-star for a dynamics model. world-model-v0 retains the baseline imagenet OMAG2 decoder where camera decoding is needed; the camera generative WM is demoted to a byproduct. The project pivots to a probabilistic state-space model (see physics-world-model-strategy); next sprint S7 stands up the Stage-1 engine. Bugs fixed en route: C5 resize, C8 frame-selection, rfid_frames_per_shot 8→32 default, merged-ckpt clobber, /tmp visibility, bench bf16-decode diagnostic toggles.

sprints.theme: Plasma state-space engine — calibrated virtual diagnostics from raw signals

items.why_now: Stage-1 of the re-founded physics-world-model strategy: prove the probabilistic state-space engine + its calibration on a cross-family raw-signal hold-out before physical grounding (GS prior) and discovery.
items.done_when: Stage-1 acceptance: filtering calibrated (88-92% coverage); forecasting a WHOLE held-out diagnostic family (Dα / camera-derived boundary) through transients beats the static deep-ensemble baseline on CRPS at horizon>0; held-out regimes flagged OOD. No EFIT labels.

sprints.summary: Closed 2026-05-30: Stage-1 cross-family state-space engine stood up + proven (QUALIFIED). On raw MAST Dα from magnetics+interferometer (EFIT-free, leakage-audited whole-family hold-out): static deep-ensemble+conformal baseline (cov 0.903) -> RKN latent-SSM engine. Headline = metric-sensitive NEGATIVE: forecast CRPS LOSES to a persistence-of-nowcast (96.8%-stationary target). Re-scoped acceptance (user A+B) MET on criteria 1+2 (filtering 0.913; transient-NLL win at h>=5, sharpened by a Student-t emission head) + criterion-3 HONEST PARTIAL (engine OOD-honest via coverage non-collapse 0.94->0.76 + sigma-inflation x3.3, but engine-native OOD-detection 0.748 does NOT beat the static ensemble 0.810). Dynamics earn their keep on calibrated catastrophic-miss-avoidance + honest widening, NOT bulk CRPS. S7.1-S7.5 + scalar-fix + baseline grad-clip landed; package imas_ambix/statespace/ (inventory/families/splits/calibration/align/dataset/baseline/engine/filter; engine_metrics_v0/v1/v2). Stage-2 (GS prior) = GO -> S8.

sprints.theme: Stage-2 — physical grounding (Grad-Shafranov soft prior) + structure discovery

items.title: Stage-2 — GS soft-prior + structure discovery
items.why_now: Stage-1 met (qualified) per S7; the GS prior grounds the latent in raw magnetics and is the principled path to a dynamics-native force-balance-departure detector that may close the Stage-1 criterion-3 OOD gap.
items.done_when: Q1: GS force-balance-departure residual validated on known transients (beats a trivial |dB/dt| baseline + survives the eddy-current ablation); first discovered reduced-structure result (effective latent dim + sparse recurrence preserving Dα skill); grounding help/hurt on Stage-1 metrics reported honestly. Raw signals only.

sprints.description: Ground the Stage-1 latent in raw magnetics via a GS soft residual (data can override); stand up GS-residual monitoring as a force-balance-departure / dynamics-native OOD detector (may close Stage-1 criterion-3); apply SINDy/Koopman to the latent transition kernel toward dimensionless/invariant coordinates. First action: scaffold a dedicated Stage-2 plan + decompose GS-prior into scoped tasks; consider the open uq-level-v0 + extrapolation-coordinates decisions.

sprints.theme: Stage-3 — MSE-free multi-modal current-profile recovery (beat EnKF)

items.why_now: The ratified pivot. Stage-1 + Stage-2 closed with honest results; recover the internal current profile WITHOUT MSE from raw multi-modal data, beating a classical EnKF baseline — the ITER-startup problem (no MSE, must still recover the current profile).
items.done_when: An MSE-free end-to-end obs->state neural filter beats the EnKF baseline on the three-axis win (MSE-observable RMSE; coverage [0.88,0.92]; CRPS/NLL on transients), validated on held-out raw MSE. The EnKF baseline + held-out-MSE eval harness are built first.

sprints.description: Build an end-to-end observation->state deep neural filter on raw multi-modal diagnostics (magnetics + ane + bolometer + SXR + visible camera + Thomson) that recovers MSE-derived internal-current observables it never sees as input, beating a classical EnKF baseline. Front-load the EnKF baseline + held-out-MSE eval harness to learn the bar early. Scope locks: observables/on-axis only (full continuous q(psi) OUT); EFIT eval-only boundary/global sanity-check; architecture = end-to-end obs->state. Grounded in the 7-reader deep review (wpy0754zv, 2026-05-31).
